spanish: Y hizo Moisés conforme a lo que mandó Jehová a él, y tomó a Josué, y lo hizo parar delante de Eleazar el sacerdote y delante de toda la congregación.

findings.issue: Hiphil of עמד licenses causing him to stand or be stationed; «hizo parar» keeps the causative and the 3ms suffix, but «parar» primarily means halt or stop.

notes: The rest matches: Moisés did as Jehová commanded him, took Josué, and set him before Eleazar the priest and all the congregation.
